sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints: traffic flow, traffic stops, sharing the road, trucks and school buses

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A02
Whether oncoming traffic stops for a school bus depends on the road: yes on two-lane roads and four-lane roads without a median, no on divided highways with a median or roads of five or more lanes with a center turn lane. [A02]
Why it matters: group school bus; difficulty three; confusable sec12-F31 vs sec12-F32. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A02
School bus lights come in two stages: yellow means the bus is about to stop, red with the STOP arm means the door is open and you must stop. [A02]
Why it matters: group school bus; difficulty two; prereq sec12-F28. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A02
Returning in front of a truck after passing uses the same test as any pass: wait until both of its headlights appear in your rearview mirror. [A02]
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty two; prereq sec12-F19. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A02
A truck or bus moving into the left lane before a right turn is setting up a wide turn; do not slip between it and the curb or shoulder. [A02]
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty two; prereq sec12-F22. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A01
In a zipper merge, using the closing lane up to the merge point is correct, not cutting in. [A01]
Why it matters: group traffic flow; difficulty two; prereq sec12-F03. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A01
Signing a ticket is not admitting guilt, but refusing to sign can get you arrested; disagreements go to court, not the roadside. [A01]
Why it matters: group traffic stops; difficulty two; confusable sec12-F13 vs sec12-F12. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A01
Lane filtering is limited to two-wheeled motorcycles passing stopped traffic at no more than 15 miles per hour, not moving traffic. [A01]
Why it matters: group sharing the road; difficulty two; prereq sec12-F15. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A02
A crossbuck is treated like a yield sign, while flashing lights or gates at a light rail crossing mean stop and do not cross. [A02]
Why it matters: group crossings; difficulty two; confusable sec12-F37 vs sec12-F35. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-co-s:colorado-department-of-revenue-division-:handbook:pdf-0023]

Misconception: you should get out and walk to the officer after being pulled over; stay in the vehicle unless told to exit. [A01]
Misconception: you may reach for your license right away; wait for the officer to ask. [A01]
Misconception: if you can see the truck, its driver can see you; No Zones hide cars around trucks and buses. [A02]
Misconception: once a train passes a lowered gate it is safe to go around; another train may come the other way. [A02]
Mnemonic: Yellow, get ready; red and arm, full stop. [A02]
Mnemonic: Both headlights in the mirror, then move back over. [A02]
Glossary: Zipper merge means alternating one car at a time from two lanes into one at the merge point. [A01]
Glossary: Lane filtering means a two-wheeled motorcycle passing stopped vehicles within the same lane at low speed. [A01]
Glossary: No Zone means a blind area around a truck or bus where its driver cannot see you. [A02]
Glossary: Runaway truck ramp means an escape lane for trucks or buses that have lost their brakes. [A02]
Glossary: Crossbuck means the railroad crossing sign that is treated the same as a yield sign. [A02]
